notify.taskHint: The task stays on your Today list either way — this only decides whether your phone rings.
notify.treatmentHint: Applies to the reminders this treatment creates: taking it off, the varroa recount, and the honey withdrawal.

db.migrationError: Something went wrong opening the database. Please close and reopen the app. If it keeps happening, report this message:

today.title: Today
today.empty: All caught up. When you or the assistant create tasks, they show up here.
today.swipeHint: Swipe a task to the right to edit it. Swipe left to delete. Tap the circle to mark it done — tap again to undo.

tasks.multiHint: {{count}} hives selected — each gets its own task, so you can check them off one by one.
tasks.historyEmpty: Nothing completed yet. Checked-off tasks stay on Today until midnight, then move here.
tasks.ruleLocked: Created by the assistant — the title and hive are fixed. You can move the date or add details.

rules.R7: Withdrawal period over — honey safe to harvest

rulesSettings.title: Assistant rules
rulesSettings.hint: The assistant reads your inspections and creates tasks and hive alerts by itself. You can tune its limits here. The active season is set automatically from each apiary's location.
rulesSettings.invalid: Please enter numbers greater than zero.

apiaries.title: Apiaries
apiaries.empty: No apiaries yet. An apiary is the place where your hives stand — create your first one below.
apiaries.name: Name
apiaries.latLngInvalid: Those coordinates look wrong — latitude must be between -90 and 90, longitude between -180 and 180.
apiaries.deleteMessage: It disappears from your lists. Its records stay in the app's data, so exports and backups still have them — but you cannot bring it back from here.
apiaries.deleteWithHives_one: {{count}} hive stands here and will be deleted with it. Its inspections stay in the app's data, but the hive disappears from your lists and you cannot bring it back from here.
apiaries.deleteWithHives_other: {{count}} hives stand here and will be deleted with it. Their inspections stay in the app's data, but the hives disappear from your lists and you cannot bring them back from here.

hives.empty: No hives here yet. Add your first hive below.
hives.label: Label
hives.deleteMessage: It disappears from your lists, and its open tasks go with it. Its inspections, queens and treatments stay in the app's data, so exports and backups still have them — but you cannot bring the hive back from here.

langstroth.label: Langstroth (standard)
langstroth.desc: The most common hive worldwide: stacked boxes with removable frames. If you bought it from a shop, it's probably this.

dadant.label: Dadant
dadant.desc: Like Langstroth but with a bigger, deeper brood box — the queen lays in one large chamber. Popular in cold climates.

top_bar.label: Top-bar
top_bar.desc: A long horizontal hive. Bees hang comb from wooden bars — no frames, no stacked boxes.

warre.label: Warré
warre.desc: A tower of small square boxes, new boxes added at the bottom. Low-intervention style.

traditional.label: Traditional
traditional.desc: Fixed-comb hives such as hollow logs, skeps, or baskets. Comb can't be removed for inspection.

other.label: Other
other.desc: Anything that doesn't fit the types above.

map.title: Map
map.empty: The offline apiary map arrives later (M9).

more.title: More
more.devSeedSkipped: Database is not empty — nothing was changed.

inspections.timelineEmpty: No inspections yet. Log your first one below — it takes under a minute.
inspections.factorsHint: Queen and eggs are always asked — they take two taps and power the alerts. Your selection is remembered for next time.
inspections.factorBroodDesc: Health of the young: larvae condition and how even the sealed brood pattern looks.
inspections.factorStoresDesc: Food supplies: how much honey and pollen the colony has.
inspections.factorConditionDesc: How strong the colony is (bees covering frames) and moisture inside the hive.
inspections.factorVarroaDesc: Mite count — visual, sticky board, alcohol wash or sugar roll. Time-consuming; skip if you didn't count.
inspections.factorPestsDesc: Beetles, wax moths, other harmful insects, and any signs of disease on brood or bees.
inspections.factorTemperamentDesc: How calm or aggressive the bees were while you worked.
inspections.varroaInvalid: Varroa count must be a whole number (0 or more).
inspections.editHint: Swipe an inspection in the timeline to edit it, or the other way to delete it.
inspections.deleteMessage: It leaves the timeline and stops counting toward this hive's condition. The record is kept, never erased.

photos.importFailed: That photo could not be added. Please try again.
photos.cameraDenied: Beearc needs permission to use the camera. You can turn it on in your phone settings.
photos.libraryDenied: Beearc needs permission to open your photos. You can turn it on in your phone settings.
photos.removeMessage: It comes off this inspection when you save. Nothing else is deleted.

queens.title: Queen
queens.replaceWarning: The queen introduced in {{date}} will be recorded as replaced. Her history is kept.
queens.noneCurrent: No queen recorded for this hive yet. Add her below and the app keeps her age for you.
queens.agingHint: She is in her third season — many beekeepers replace a queen at this age.

treatments.title: Treatments
treatments.empty: No treatments recorded for this hive. Logging them here is what lets the app warn you before you treat again.
treatments.durationHint: The assistant reminds you to take it off after this many days. What the box in your hand says beats what the app guessed.
treatments.withdrawalHint: Days after removal before honey is safe to harvest. Check the product label — 0 means no waiting, "Not set" means the app stays quiet about it.
treatments.endMessage: It will be recorded as removed today, and the assistant will remind you to recount varroa afterwards.
treatments.lastWarningBody: {{product}}, started {{date}} ({{ago}}). Treating again too soon risks overdosing the colony and residue in the honey.
treatments.planMessage: The mite count was over your limit. Do you want to record the treatment now?

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.empty: Nothing recorded on this hive yet. Writing supers and other gear down here is what reminds you to take them off again.
equipment.removeMessage: {{item}} will be recorded as taken off today. It stays in the history.
equipment.deleteMessage: It leaves this hive's equipment list. The record is kept, never erased.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.empty: Nothing has moved in or out of this hive yet. Record a frame of brood you gave or took, and it appears in both hives' histories.
transfers.noOtherHives: No other hives in this apiary. Choose another apiary, or add a second hive first.
transfers.notesPlaceholder: e.g. equalizing, boosting the weak one
transfers.deleteMessage: It disappears from both hives' histories. The record is kept, never erased.
